headline: One 97 Communications Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - One 97 Communications Limited has informed the Exchange about Additional investment by the Company into Paytm Cloud Technologies Limited ("PCTL"), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company and the subsequent investment by PCTL…
detail: Acquisition - One 97 Communications Limited has informed the Exchange about Additional investment by the Company into Paytm Cloud Technologies Limited ("PCTL"), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company and the subsequent investment by PCTL into its wholly owned subsidiary, namely Paytm Singapore Pte.
